title: Identity Schema
description: Defines identity constructs, roles, traits, tags, and resonance-identity coupling for entities within the Resonance Substrate Model (RSM). Supports semantic identity, distributed agents, substrate entities, and symbolic coherence structures.

label.description: Human-readable name or label for the entity.

roles.description: Functional or symbolic roles assigned to the entity.

traits.description: Key-value attributes describing inherent or emergent characteristics.

tags.description: Lightweight classification tags for grouping or filtering.

resonance_signature.description: Defines how the entity participates in resonance-based interactions.

amplitude_bias.description: Bias or weighting applied to resonance amplitude.

phase_bias.description: Bias or offset applied to resonance phase.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for documentation, provenance, or schema evolution.
